faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the E-Buggy Driver post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the E-Buggy Driver post at Sanjay Gandhi National Park Borivali is 09 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the E-Buggy Driver position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the E-Buggy Driver position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 17000. This is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum qualifications required for the E-Buggy Driver role?
faq.answer: The primary qualification required for the E-Buggy Driver position is a valid driving licence. Further details might be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the SGNP Borivali E-Buggy Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the E-Buggy Driver post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview and a driving test. Final selection will be based on merit and suitability.

faq.answer: The E-Buggy Driver position is a contractual job. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the terms of the contract.
